summary: This note covers the revival of the Desert Diamond West Valley Phoenix Grand Prix, an IndyCar race that returned in 2016 after an eleven-year hiatus. The race was held on a Saturday night under the lights. The note also recalls Phoenix's history as a popular open-wheel racing venue, citing a notable crash involving Johnny Rutherford in 1980 and Mario Andretti's final career victory in 1993.
one_line: Overview of the Desert Diamond West Valley Phoenix Grand Prix, revived by IndyCar in 2016 and noted for Phoenix's open-wheel racing history.
key_facts: The Desert Diamond West Valley Phoenix Grand Prix was revived by the Verizon IndyCar Series in 2016.
The race had been on hiatus for eleven years before its 2016 revival.
The 2016 race was held on Saturday night under the lights.
Phoenix was long considered a popular Indy car track.
Phoenix has a rich history of open wheel races.
The note mentions a spectacular crash involving Johnny Rutherford in 1980 at Phoenix.
Mario Andretti earned the final career victory of his career at Phoenix in 1993.
Mario Andretti is described in the note as an Indy legend.
The note frames the Phoenix open-wheel history as including both a crash and a final career win.
